Chapter 1393 - 11: The Great Emperor Sweeps The Current Era In His Twilight Years

Chapter 1393: Chapter 11: The Great Emperor Sweeps the Current Era in His Twilight Years

The supreme emperors of the You Clan arrived personally, making no effort to conceal, their aura of ancient supreme rulers spreading, blocking the sun and the sky.

At that moment, the numerous cultivators of the Human Race immediately sensed something, and their gazes turned towards the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

"The supreme beings of the alien race have attacked the Palace."

"These supreme beings of the alien race dared not show themselves during the peak period of our Emperor Tianyuan, and now that the Great Emperor is nearing the end of his life, they all come out one by one."

"Truly shameless indeed."

Many Human Race cultivators looked grave and indignant, yet there was nothing they could do.

Emperor Tianyuan had overlooked the Great Wilderness for over two million years, during which all major alien races were compliant.

Even the legendary forbidden zones never caused any disturbances, unwilling to challenge the prosperous Emperor Tianyuan.

"Hopefully... the Great Emperor will be alright."

This was the hope within the hearts of the Human Race cultivators.

As early as a hundred thousand years ago, Emperor Tianyuan had already been preparing for this day.

He had voluntarily relocated the Human Race strong practitioners around the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, dispersing them to various regions.

Moreover, he issued orders that no matter what transpired in the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, no Human Race strong practitioner was allowed to approach.

Emperor Tianyuan had foreseen that, in his twilight years, certain ancient supreme emperors would become restless.

"You Clan."

Within the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, a figure shot skyward, a white-haired old man, whose expression was solemn as he gazed at the overlooking You Clan supreme beings, "Does your You Clan intend to breach the alliance made with my Human Race?"

During the prime of Emperor Tianyuan, alliances had been forged with other powerful clan supremes to not attack each other.

The You Clan was naturally among them.

"An alliance?"

A supreme from the You Clan sneered, "What can you do if we breach the alliance?"

The so-called alliance was not without binding power, witnessed by the heavenly laws.

Yet for those supreme emperors who once roamed the world, they could still bear the backlash from breaking the alliance.

The white-haired old man’s face turned ugly; he had not expected the You Clan’s supreme to be so shameless, blatantly disregarding the alliance.

"Retreat now."

Another You Clan supreme looked coldly upon the white-haired old man.

This Human Race cultivator was a quasi-emperor, capable of posing some trouble if he fought to the death against these supremes.

Though it couldn’t really be called trouble, as even if the You Clan’s several supremes self-severed once, their strength was still far above a so-called quasi-emperor.

However, the former’s vitality and spirit were nearly exhausted, every bit of power used would be gone permanently, and the You Clan’s supremes were unwilling to waste any effort on a quasi-emperor.

Their target had always been solely the same—

Emperor Tianyuan.

Only by devouring this world’s Great Emperor and absorbing the Origin Source could they continue to survive by a thin thread.

"If you want to make a move against the Great Emperor, you’ll have to step over my corpse."

The white-haired old man’s gaze was resolute; he was old and frail, with no possibility of becoming an Emperor, hence willing to guard the Palace and be laid to rest with Emperor Tianyuan.

"In that case, die."

The third supreme from the You Clan frowned and took action decisively.

Though they were reluctant to waste any power on a mere quasi-emperor, it didn’t mean they could let him act recklessly before them.

Rumble.

An invisible aura covered the white-haired old man, with even the heavenly laws yielding to some extent.

As a former sovereign supreme, even if he had self-severed, his power was immensely great; if not for the price of every strike and the need to spend most time in slumber.

How could there be a birth of Emperor Tianyuan?

"I’m going all out."

The white-haired old man took a deep breath; facing an ancient supreme emperor still left him with no chance of victory.

But even in death, he would take a bite out of his foe.

At that moment.

Thump—

A faint footstep resounded.

From the depths of the Palace, a figure emerged.

The moment this figure appeared, the heavenly laws naturally fell silent.

The You Clan supreme’s strike was instantly dissipated.

"Great Emperor."

The eyes of the white-haired old man reddened.

"Tianyuan."

The expressions of the You Clan supremes grew grave.

They too had once overlooked the Great Wilderness Origin World as emperors, aware of how formidable such an existence was.

In terms of battle strength, if the You Clan’s supremes were fully revived, they could possess the true battle strength of an Emperor Level figure.

Yet they couldn’t last long; each revival demanded a dreadful toll.

This was why during Emperor Tianyuan’s peak, no lingering supreme dared to make a move.

For Emperor Tianyuan, no matter the consumption, could quickly recover; but these ancient supreme emperors could not and would be entirely exhausted to death.

"Indeed, I forgot about you little bugs."

Lin Yuan looked at the several You Clan supremes, speaking in a calm tone.

Since arriving, his goal had always been the Red Dust Immortal and the beings above the Red Dust Immortal.

Only beings of similar times and levels could pose a slight threat to Lin Yuan.

"Tianyuan, you’re too arrogant."

The strongest You Clan supreme finally spoke.

He had been observing the movements within the Palace, and now with Lin Yuan appearing, he chose to speak.

The other You Clan supremes frowned as well.

Even if they self-severed and lost their peak powers, to be described as ’little bugs’?

"Tianyuan, you are approaching the end of your second life, how much power can you exert, and dare to fight with all your might? What difference is there between us?"

The You Clan supremes successively spoke.

With the impending limit of Emperor Tianyuan’s second lifespan and the self-severed supreme emperors, there was no significant difference as neither dared to strike with full force.
